I applied in a rush because my parent pressured me to take the earliest admission possible. After finishing my English proficiency test on March 25th, I began to take action to submit my applications on the same day, but due to technical issues leading to non-existent communication with my professor before the deadline, I wasn't able to submit everything by April 1st, and after fulfilling LOR yesterday, I asked for a review from the administration and received a rejection 10 minutes after. I would like to have more insights into my case, whether it is because of my late submission of the documents, my application itself, etc., to improve on future applications.
